# visionary Provider

Manage Visionary alert rules, notification channels, silences, uptime checks, dashboards and API keys as code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    visionary = {
      source = "styropyr0/visionary"
    }
  }
}

# An editor key manages alerts, checks and dashboards; an admin key also
# manages API keys. Create one in Settings → API keys.
provider "visionary" {
  url = "https://visionary.example.com"
  # api_key = "vis_..."  # or set VISIONARY_API_KEY
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) An API key with the editor scope (or admin, to manage API keys) from Settings → API keys. Defaults to the VISIONARY_API_KEY environment variable.
- `url` (String) Visionary's address, such as https://visionary.example.com. Defaults to the VISIONARY_URL environment variable.
